using UnityEngine;

namespace Game.Progression
{
    public sealed class SaveKeyResolver
    {
        const string k_saveKeyPrefix = "progression.slot.";

        public string GetKey(int slot)
        {
            var key = k_saveKeyPrefix + slot.ToString();
            var secretHandshakeValue = ComputeHandshakeForSlot(slot);
            return key + ":" + secretHandshakeValue;
        }

        static string ComputeHandshakeForSlot(int slot) => slot.ToString("X8");
    }
}
